**The Organizational Origins of Misalignment** — the manuscript ChatGPT proposed in the exchange "Alignment consequences brainstorm" (2026-11-26) from the owner's U4 (the paperclip problem is which optimization objectives may steer significant levers of behavioural influence, and the attention economy already does it): titled at A8 "We Are Already Paperclip Maximizing: Optimization Jurisdiction and the Organizational Origins of Misalignment" after its six cases, and outlined at A11 §IX as "Optimization Without a Sovereign: The Organizational Origins of Misalignment" in five propositions. Optimization can be organized without a sovereign maximizer; an objective fails by its jurisdiction more than its content, reshapes the feedback that constrains it, and its success erodes the capacities that would evaluate and correct it; the alternative is the governed coexistence of heterogeneous demands.
